an8.18:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati,
an8.18:1.5: bhaṇitena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. gītena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati. ruṇṇena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati.
an8.18:1.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi ākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati,
an8.18:1.12: te bhikkhave sattā subaddhā ye phassena baddhāti.
